newsitem.title: UK: Juppe says Thomson may be split - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says Thomson may be split - newspaper.

text.p: Defence and consumer electronics group Thomson SA could be split in two to ensure the speedy sale of its Thomson-CSF defence division, French Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Monday.
In an interview with the Financial Times newspaper, Juppe promised a rapid relaunch for the privatisation of Thomson, which was called off last Wednesday.

The sale of Thomson to missile maker Lagardere Groupe was abandoned after France's independent privatisation commission criticised Lagardere's plans to sell Thomson Multimedia on to Daewoo Electronics of South Korea.
Juppe suggested that the sale of the heavily indebted Multimedia could come after that of Thomson-CSF, reversing the government's previous position that the two had to be sold together.
"It is the privatisation of Multimedia that poses a problem," he said, adding that the consumer electronics business "requires a significant recapitalisation...before putting it on the market."
